interpretation.normal: Pending SessionStart precedes initial UPS input processing on normal turn path.
interpretation.exceptions: Error/cancellation input preservation paths are not an ordering guarantee.
interpretation.turnIdentity: Steered user input reuses current turn context; revision + turn required.

model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.

model_auto_compact_token_limit_scope.description: Controls whether the auto-compaction limit applies to the full context or only to tokens after the carried prefix in the current compaction window.

scopeDefinition.description: Selects which part of the active context is charged against `model_auto_compact_token_limit`.

oneOf.description: Count the full active context against the limit.
Count sampled output and later growth after the carried window prefix.
